Name: Joanna
Summary: Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, was healed by Jesus and then travelled with Him, supporting His ministry from her own means. She was among the women who found the empty tomb and told the apostles.
KeyStory: Joanna went from Herod's household to the empty tomb, and carried the resurrection news to the apostles.
LifeLesson: Faith reaches into unlikely households. Joanna served Jesus out of Herod's court and witnessed His rising.
